en.title: Generate spoken narration
en.description: Turn approved text into narration with the bundled OpenAI Audio API client.
tasks: Turn approved text into narration with the bundled OpenAI Audio API client.
prerequisites: Python, the openai package, OPENAI_API_KEY, and API billing access.
en.example: Use speech. Generate a calm narration of this 150-word script and save an MP3 for review.
en.expectedResult: An audio file with the requested text, delivery, and output format.
limitations: API calls incur usage costs; custom voice creation is outside this Skill’s scope.

zh.title: 生成语音旁白
zh.description: 通过包内 OpenAI Audio API 客户端把确认后的文本转成旁白。
tasks: 通过包内 OpenAI Audio API 客户端把确认后的文本转成旁白。
prerequisites: Python、openai 包、OPENAI_API_KEY 与 API 计费权限。
zh.example: 请使用 speech：为这段 150 字文稿生成平静的旁白，并保存 MP3 供检查。
zh.expectedResult: 符合指定文本、表达方式与格式的音频文件。
limitations: API 调用产生费用；此 Skill 不负责创建自定义声音。
